docs: ### AspectRatio Displays content within a desired aspect ratio, preserving proportions responsively across viewport sizes with ratio presets and skeleton loading placeholders. **Import Path**: ```typescript import { AspectRatio } from "@/components/ui/aspectRatio/aspectRatio"; ``` #### Preset Ratios (preset) Use predefined ratio aliases ('video', 'square', 'golden', 'cinema', 'portrait', 'ultrawide'). ```tsx ... ... ... ``` #### Loading Skeleton Placeholder (isLoading) Display a pulsing skeleton container while high-resolution media is loading. ```tsx ``` #### Props — AspectRatio Properties for configuring the AspectRatio component. | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |---|---|---|---| | preset | 'video' | 'square' | 'golden' | 'cinema' | 'portrait' | 'ultrawide' | — | Preset aspect ratio alias. Takes precedence over custom numeric ratio. | | ratio | number | 16 / 9 | Desired custom width-to-height numeric ratio (e.g. 16/9, 4/3, 1/1). | | isLoading | boolean | false | Shows an integrated skeleton loading spinner state inside the container frame. |
